correctness.rationale: For odd k, kth power is bijective on the odd unit group mod 2^n. Parity yields exactly 2^n ordered odd-target solutions and 2^{n-1} odd-odd pairs for even targets. For n≤k even-even pairs contribute only to residue zero, 2^{2n-2}; for n>k divide even x,y by 2, and each low-level root pair has 2^{2(k-1)} lifts. After scaling by 2^{-n}, each successive valuation block of length k multiplies density by B=2^{k-2}; nonzero a stabilizes, zero diverges. Haar shell measure 2^{-v-1} gives the geometric moment criterion 2^{-k}B^q<1 including divergence at equality, and tail power law. The m1 identity 3/4+m1/4 gives one; m2=7/8+2^{k-4}m2 yields 7/4 for cubes and divergence otherwise. Independent direct enumeration for k∈{3,5,7,9} and n≤8 checked all residues and ordered input pairs against recurrence; finite checks corroborate analytical all-n proof.
